# 98. W18 CODE AUDIT + GL / MAP PREVIEW COMPAT REPAIR — **ALL BUILT, BUILD GREEN, NONE FIELD-TESTED**

**98.a THE AUDIT (four mechanical passes, harness in `%TEMP%/abscan/`).** Corpus 135 files / 50,336 lines / 357 types / 1,236 methods / 115 attributed + 18 manual Harmony patches. Findings: **12 dead methods** (verified twice — token scan then raw grep, so reflection-by-name is excluded); **28 maximal clone pairs, largest 10 logic lines** (nothing structural; not worth the rule-50 risk); **16 cache-hostile x-outer/z-inner loops** on row-major grids; **54 silent catches of 303**; **5 targets patched by 2+ of our own classes** (`GenerateContentsIntoMap` ×3, `TerrainGrid.SetTerrain` ×2, `RoofGrid.SetRoof` ×2, `DrawDynamicThings` ×2, `ParallelGetPreRenderResults` ×2). **CLEAN:** zero TODO/FIXME/HACK; no leaking statics (every never-cleared collection is keyed by `Type`/`Def`/`string`/int, and `ABColumnNetworks.all` is an idempotent def-level scan); both hottest patches already optimal. ⚠ TWO PASS-3 HEURISTIC FALSE POSITIVES worth remembering: `ABCameraBounds.Summary` is button-triggered not per-frame, and `Dialog_ABCameraCalibration` is dev-only — call-graph reachability over-reports, always confirm the caller.

**98.b THE FIVE PROVEN DEFECTS (GL 1.7.13.1 / Map Preview 1.12.26 sources, cross-checked against the INSTALLED 1.6 dlls).**
1. `MapPreviewCompat.RaiseSizeCaps` looked up field `"MapSizeOverride"`; the live binary has **`GameInitMapSizeOverride`**. Silent no-op for an unknown number of versions — harmless only because the Harmony postfix covered the same case, which is why nobody noticed. Its dead guard `AlreadyStacked` was the tell (rule 62).
2. We fought the supported API: MapPreview 1.6 exposes `MapSizeUtility.MapSizeTransforms` (their own VEF bridge uses it), and our `DetermineMapSize` postfix **replaced `__result`**, discarding any other mod's transform.
3. `ABGenProfile` armed on Map Preview's **background generation thread**, because it gated on `TryPendingSurfaceRect` (true for previews by design) instead of on `pending`.
4. GL's `ApplyBuffered(map.Size, …)` evaluates each landform module over the **entire stacked column** — 145,920 cells where 36,480 matter, ×4 modules — and paints the surface band with out-of-domain output.
5. `BiomeTransition.PostProcessBiomeGrid` flood-fills across band seams over the whole column.

**98.c ⚠⚠ THE "MISSING CHUNKS" ROOT CAUSE, AND THE TWO-PART FIX (§56n + §56m).** Genstep order is `ElevationFertility(10) → MutatorPostElevationFertility(20) → RocksFromGrid(200) → Terrain(210) → MutatorPostTerrain(220)`. Our elevation transplant COPIES (deliberately, not moves), so the anchor rows keep landform elevation; RocksFromGrid is suppressed only in SKY bands (basement deliberately keeps vanilla rock, §ABDoomedBands), so the anchor rows — which live in band 0 — get rock everywhere the landform is mountainous. GL's `TerrainAt` then returns **null** under any full-fillage edifice, `SetTerrain` skips those cells, and the whole-slice lift carried the anchor's BASEMENT terrain up into the surface band. Result: the landform's terrain is missing exactly along its high-elevation contours. **FIX = `Patch_GL_ABAnchorScope`** (prefix clamps `mapSize.z` to the anchor height on both closed generics `<float>` and `<TerrainDef>`; ApplyBuffered derives buffer AND both loop bounds from that one argument, so this is a one-line change that also removes the 4× waste) **PLUS the restored per-cell write mask** in `Patch_TerrainGrid_ABLandformWriteProbe` + `LiftTerrainSlice`. ⚠⚠ NEITHER MAY SHIP ALONE — see rule 77 and the §56m banner: the mask was reverted once because GL painted the destination (run #40: 13,001 anchor open cells → 4,191 surface), and only the clamp retires that. Guarded by `AnchorScopedGeneration`, which requires BOTH generic instantiations to resolve (a half-resolve disables the feature and warns — §95.j's corollary to rule 33).

**98.d WHAT WAS CHANGED.** `§56n` anchor scope; `§56m` authored-cell terrain lift + mask; `§56p` `Patch_GL_ABBiomeTransitionScope` (suppresses the cross-seam flood fill on banded maps, fails open); `§56q` `TryRegisterSizeTransform` (registers a `MapSizeTransform` by reflection — their delegate type, our all-vanilla signature — and DISARMS the Harmony postfix so the inflation can never double-apply; postfix remains the rule-33 fallback for older builds); `ABBandedGeneration.RealGenerationInFlight` (new gate: "is this the real colony", distinct from "what is this map's layout" — the one every owner of SHARED MUTABLE STATE must use); 9 GL transplant loops reordered z-outer/x-inner; `PlaceWorker_ABLinkApproach.DrawGhost` list reuse; `ABMapSizeLimit.ChooserStrings` memo (12 `Translate()` + 4 `N0` per frame → rebuilt only on change, **keyed on `LanguageDatabase.activeLanguage`** so a language switch cannot serve stale strings).

**98.e DELIBERATELY NOT CHANGED, WITH REASONS (do not "fix" these).** **C4 `CompMemo`** — its `readonly` fields are the lock-free publish contract (§91); mutable statics would open a torn read on the preview thread, and it allocates once per MAP SWITCH (once in the measured 719,002-call burst). **riverFlowMap lift loop** — GL indexes `(x * Size.z + z) * 2`, X-MAJOR, so x-outer is already the sequential order there; it is the one loop in that file that must NOT match the others. **`SectionLayer_ABBelowSnow` L110** — its own comment: iteration order must match `MakeBaseGeometry`'s nine-vertices-per-cell contract. **`SectionLayer_ABBelowSnow` L267** — cache is `(x * cacheHeight) + z`, already sequential. **Shadows L156 / V2Water L260** — 289-cell and 17×17 walks on mesh rebuild; no measurable gain against real churn risk. **11 remaining dead methods** — left pending a keep/delete ruling; two (`TryResolveClicked`, `DebugCapFillInfo`) are documented as deliberately kept.

**98.f ⚠ WHAT IS STILL UNKNOWN.** The desk audit could NOT prove a preview-vs-real MISMATCH mechanism: size flow, crop (`TexCoords`, consumed once at `MapPreviewWidget:189`), the `TryInferredSurfaceRect` fallback and `surfaceBand` agreement (`pending.surfaceBand` and the inference both read `ABV2.SurfaceBand`) all check out, and the `MaxStackedZ=1024` ceiling is genuinely adequate (worst case 126×7 = z 896). If previews still disagree after §98, the next move is an instrumented A/B that generates preview and real at one seed and diffs the surface band cell-by-cell, reporting the first divergent cell and the genstep that wrote it — NOT more desk theory (rules 17/37).
